title: Leave an auditable trail
why: Without a checkpoint convention each session ends wherever it ended, and the next one re-derives decisions that were already made. The failure is quiet: nothing breaks, the work is just done twice and the second answer sometimes differs from the first.
fix: Add a session-end or checkpoint command that appends to a single append-only log, and name that log in CLAUDE.md so an agent knows to read and write it. One file, one owner, appended never rewritten.
